title: Complete TikTok account and monetization audit
description: Open the relevant TikTok account, inspect all monetization features, record account standing, and preserve screenshots. Do not assume eligibility based solely on public thresholds.
blockers: Owner must provide redacted screenshots of TikTok profile, Studio, account status, monetization features, analytics, and link-in-bio settings.
reason: Audit framework is complete, but live TikTok account facts and screenshots remain unverified.

title: Create TikTok content-safety standard
description: Write the prohibited-positioning list, standard educational disclaimer, and publication stop conditions for TikTok content.

title: Create claim-classification matrix
description: Define V1–V5 claim classifications and LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/PROHIBITED risk ratings with examples relevant to consumer-law education.

title: Audit current TikTok profile and bio
description: Review existing profile photo, bio, link-in-bio, pinned videos, and content history against the brand positioning and safety framework.
blockers: Owner must provide redacted profile screenshots or conduct live owner-guided inspection.
reason: Profile framework and draft bio are complete; live account profile elements cannot be audited without owner access.

title: Draft Consumer Evidence Case Starter Sheet
description: Create the free lead magnet: a one-page intake worksheet with case summary, party list, timeline, document inventory, communication log, deadlines, desired resolution, missing evidence, and questions requiring professional review.

title: Build Consumer Evidence Intake Pack outline
description: Define the $9 entry product contents, file structure, and educational-use terms.

title: Draft first ten video scripts
description: Produce scripts for the first ten videos from the initial twenty-video list, using the full script structure in the master mission.
note: Script index with titles, pillars, risk ratings, and CTAs completed. Full scripts pending source-packet verification.

title: Verify legal claims in first ten scripts
description: Attach a source packet to each moderate- or high-risk script. Classify every claim V1–V5 and assign risk rating.
note: Preliminary source packets attached. Athena must finalize jurisdiction-specific wording before production.

title: Create landing-page wireframe
description: Design the landing page for the Consumer Evidence Intake Pack with problem statement, inclusions, exclusions, price, disclaimer, checkout, privacy notice, and UTM tracking.

title: Create analytics dashboard schema
description: Define video-level and business metrics, content classification rules, and weekly experiment tracking schema.

title: Prepare first LIVE agenda
description: Build the Consumer Evidence Clinic agenda, moderation rules, question-routing framework, and comment-mining template.

title: Identify ten TikTok Shop product candidates
description: Score at least ten candidate products using the 35/50 scoring model and produce an affiliate shortlist aligned with document/evidence workflows.
note: Candidate shortlist completed; live TikTok Shop listing verification still pending account access.

title: Create TikTok One sponsor-profile draft
description: Draft creator profile, sponsor target list, media kit, rate card, and contract checklist for brand collaboration opportunities.
note: Profile draft complete. Account metrics and live TikTok One availability need verification.

title: Establish evidence repository structure
description: Create subfolders for gate checklists, screenshots, URLs, and verification evidence; write README explaining naming conventions.

title: Issue Day One mission status report
description: Publish the Day One status report with current state, task queue, gates in progress, risks, and decisions needed.

title: Collect owner G-0 evidence
description: Receive redacted screenshots or conduct live owner-guided inspection of TikTok account.
note: Do not mark complete until evidence is actually received.

title: Review and classify owner evidence
description: Assign Evidence IDs, perform sensitive-data review, record acceptance status, and transfer verified facts to G0_FINDINGS.md.

title: Close or retain G-0
description: Update gate decision based on verified evidence; retain PENDING if any required field is unresolved.
note: Do not mark complete merely because a checklist exists.

title: Add preview feature flag
description: Add SP_TKM_001_PREVIEW_ENABLED setting and guard router registration in portal/main.py.

title: Certify router and startup behavior
description: Verify import, startup with flag disabled/enabled, route tests, regression tests, and document results.
note: Certified for internal feature-flagged use only.

title: Owner-review scripts 001–020
description: Use SCRIPT_OWNER_REVIEW.md decision record to approve, edit, revise, hold, or reject each script.
note: Do not mark complete without owner decisions.

title: Certify source packets
description: Verify each moderate-risk packet contains current primary authority, correct jurisdiction, exceptions, date checked, safe wording, prohibited wording, citation.
note: Twelve packets certified; eight remain PRELIMINARY pending human review or jurisdiction-specific wording.

title: Review product artifacts
description: Evaluate each product for completeness, accuracy, usability, privacy, unauthorized-practice risk, marketing-claim risk, delivery readiness.
note: All products INTERNAL DRAFT or INTERNAL REVIEWED; none REVENUE READY.

title: Verify business mailbox
description: Confirm ISIAHH@ikesolutions.org accepts inbound mail, owner can read, reply works, spam routing acceptable, signature exists, inquiry separation ready.
note: Do not mark complete without a successful mailbox test.

title: Confirm domain and route architecture
description: Document intended public URL, internal route, DNS/reverse-proxy dependencies, authentication strategy, and staging plan.

title: Produce Phase Three return
description: Compile Phase Three status report with corrected isolation language, feature-flag evidence, router certification, test results, G-0 inventory, product/script/mailbox status, gate table, and decision.

title: Resolve or formally waive unrelated SSO test dependency
description: Classify why portal/routers/tests/test_sso_routes.py cannot be collected; record allowed outcome.
note: Classification recorded as NOT EXECUTED / missing itsdangerous / no mission attribution. Allowed outcomes preserved.
